name: l_bracket_rib
description: Aluminium L-bracket with triangular reinforcement rib — dimensional + feature gates plus a standalone FEM check.

stages.prompt:
Aluminium L-bracket (6061) with a triangular reinforcement rib, fully parametric.

Frame: bottom face of the base plate lies on the XY plane (z = 0); the part is centred on the origin in X and Y. mm units.

- Base flange: 80 (X) x 60 (Y) x 6 thick plate, spanning x = -40..+40, z = 0..6.
- Upright flange: 60 (Y) wide x 6 thick in X, standing on the base top face at the -X edge — it spans x = -40..-34 and z = +6..+66, so the total part height is 66 mm.
- Two M8 clearance holes dia 8.5 mm through the base flange along Z at (x=+25, y=+20) and (x=+25, y=-20).
- Two M8 clearance holes dia 8.5 mm through the upright flange along X at (y=+20, z=+36) and (y=-20, z=+36).
- One triangular reinforcement rib: 4 mm thick, centred in Y (y = -2..+2), in the inner corner joining the base top face to the upright's +X face; legs ~40 mm long along each face.
- Fillets: 3 mm radius in the inner L corner and where the rib meets both plates; 2 mm radius on the remaining outer edges.
The part is symmetric about the XZ mid-plane and must be dimensionally exact. Expose all key dimensions as named parameters.
